verdict.rationale: Claude Code can plug third-party, partner-hosted integrations into workflows through MCP. The docs say it connects to hundreds of external tools, show a Notion-hosted MCP endpoint added with one command, and describe Jira/Slack/Google Drive workflows. They also reference an official plugin, which implies a plugin mechanism. However, these are mostly tool and data connectors rather than partner-built agent apps, and the pack shows no partner agent marketplace or directory. Missing for 10: evidence of a third-party/partner agent-app marketplace or catalog, documentation of installing partner-built agents (vs. tools), governance or vetting of partner apps, and independent hands-on corroboration.
